subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should this issue be split into a narrow Feishu outbound hook parity fix while normal-channel `inbound_claim` expansion is handled as a separate plugin API/security decision?
rationale: The outbound hook gap is a source-reproducible bug, but broadcasting `inbound_claim` for ordinary channel traffic changes which plugins can claim messages before agent routing.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu `message_sending`/`reply_payload_sending`/`message_sent` parity first and open or revive a separate tracker for the normal-channel `inbound_claim` contract.

options.title: Fold Feishu into canonical hook work
options.body: Treat the Feishu outbound gap as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92374 and require the canonical PR to prove Feishu bot/comment coverage before this issue closes.

options.title: Solve all requested hooks together
options.body: Land one broader PR covering Feishu outbound parity and normal-channel `inbound_claim`, accepting higher security and compatibility review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu `message_sending`/`reply_payload_sending`/`message_sent` parity first and open or revive a separate tracker for the normal-channel `inbound_claim` contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans plugin hook semantics and security-sensitive claim behavior, where Vincent has the strongest visible adjacent review and hardening signal.
